bullets.title: LEAD - ANTHROPIC REDESIGNED CLAUDE PROJECTS ON 17 SEP SO A PROJECT STOPS BEING A FOLDER OF INSTRUCTIONS AND BECOMES ONE LONG-RUNNING CONVERSATION, WITH A COORDINATOR THAT SCOPES, DELEGATES TO PARALLEL THREADS OVER SHARED MEMORY AND A COMMON FILE LIBRARY, REVIEWS OUTPUTS AND ASSEMBLES THE RESULT - FEATURE FOR FEATURE THE THING THE CONSTRUCT HAS BEEN HAND-BUILDING OUT OF HERMES DISPATCH, THE WORKER QUEUE AND THE PARALLEL-AGENT CONTRACT
bullets.summary: Announced 17 September 2026, in beta. A project is now threads that do the work plus a coordinator that directs them: the user describes the outcome and Claude scopes, delegates, coordinates parallel threads, reviews outputs and assembles the finished result over shared memory and a common library of files and artifacts. Previously the user split the work, managed handoffs by hand and recombined at the end. Work continues after you step away from the computer and can be steered from a phone. Beta opened to Pro and Max subscribers who use cloud sessions in Claude Code AND HAVE NO EXISTING PROJECTS on web or desktop, widening over the following week, with the rest of Claude plus Team and Enterprise after. Archive grep across 82 files: 'Projects redesigned' ZERO, 'folder to conversation' ZERO. Method honesty: the claude.com primary returned a provenance-set refusal and was served by search plus trade press - declared, not silently substituted.
bullets.how: YES, three reads. (i) ARCHITECTURE: every load-bearing piece of the Construct's agent layer exists because the platform lacked this - hermes-agent-control dispatch, hermes-worker-queue, swarm-strategy-review, vironbox-parallel-agent-contract, and the manual discipline of splitting, handing off and recombining. The vendor shipped the coordinator. It does NOT touch the credentialed arm (Hermes holds the Mac GitHub credential and the deploy SSH key; a cloud coordinator does not), so the likely shape is coordinator above, Hermes still the executor arm below - the maestro/executor split hermes-agent already describes. (ii) ELIGIBILITY TRAP: beta requires NO EXISTING PROJECTS on web or desktop. We have projects. That is a concrete, checkable reason we may be excluded from the first wave of a change to our own execution environment - exactly what item (q) exists to catch before it becomes another five-fire miss. Hence new item (r). (iii) ITEM (a): a coordinator that delegates, reviews and assembles is a SECOND unlogged decision point stacked on the auto-router flagged at 10:00. Two new routing layers in one day, both above our instrumentation, on the same day the design requirement 'the log must record what ran the action' was written.

bullets.title: ANTHROPIC EXPANDED CLAUDE FOR SMALL BUSINESS ON 15 SEP TO 43 WORKFLOWS AND 27 NEW INTEGRATIONS ACROSS 37 CONNECTORS, ON 900,000+ INSTALLS SINCE MAY, WITH NAMED WORKFLOWS /speed-to-lead, /proposal-builder, /monday-brief AND /close-month - THE VENDOR IS NOW SELLING PRAGMA'S WEDGE DIRECTLY TO PRAGMA'S BUYER, ON EVERY PAID PLAN, WITH FREE WORKSHOPS IN TEN CITIES
bullets.summary: Dateline read at the primary: 'September 15, 2026', claude.com/blog. The May launch has been installed more than 900,000 times; the roster is 37 connectors including Shopify, Salesforce, TikTok Ads, Atlassian, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe, Zapier, Apollo, Clay, Ramp, RingCentral, Wix, Airwallex, MYOB, NetSuite, Expensify and the Zoho suite. Stated reason for the expansion: about a third of 1,000+ owners across 10 cities asked for help GROWING the business - leads, inbound inquiries, proposals. Runs in Claude Cowork on every paid plan, Team recommended above one person. Distribution: free half-day workshops with Tenex in Boston, Pittsburgh, Detroit, Minneapolis, Phoenix, Memphis, Savannah, Bentonville, Tampa, Raleigh; 150+ organizations trained as Approved Claude SMB Trainers running 750+ of their own workshops; 14 integration partners each hosting a free connector webinar late Sep-Nov; Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses and IncuVersity as community partners. Archive grep across 82 files: '900,000' ZERO, '43 workflows' ZERO, '27 integrations' ZERO, 'SMB Tour' ZERO, 'speed-to-lead' ZERO, 'proposal-builder' ZERO, 'Xero' ZERO, 'Gusto' ZERO - and the six files containing 'Small Business' are a PaperCut CVE victim profile and the 26 Aug Runable raise, none of them this product.
bullets.how: YES, and it is the uncomfortable one. (i) THIS IS PRAGMA'S WEDGE, SHIPPED. PRAGMA sells an AI-operator layer to small businesses; Anthropic now ships 43 pre-built workflows into the same buyer's existing tools, on a plan they may already pay for, with a trainer network and a workshop in ten cities. The archive holds the adjacent datapoint and can now connect it - 26 Aug, Runable raised $21M to point an SMB agent at exactly PRAGMA's wedge - but that was one startup and this is the platform vendor at 900,000 installs with Goldman Sachs handing out the curriculum. What PRAGMA has left as a differentiator is NOT workflow breadth, it is MEASUREMENT AND ATTRIBUTION - AAIR, the citation loop, the Results Log - none of which is in this release. (ii) B9 IS LITERALLY THE CASE-STUDY PROFILE: the primary quotes an owner who made '$20,000 in the last month and a half using Claude to do these professional proposals' and another whose agent 'at 6:00 am every morning... goes and looks through our CRM'. Brand 9 runs both by hand. /proposal-builder and /monday-brief are worth a one-hour test against the real B9 workflow this week - the result is either a saved afternoon or a demo for a PRAGMA prospect. (iii) The 14-partner webinar calendar (Notion 25 Sep, RingCentral 1 Oct, Zoom 8 Oct, monday.com 12 Oct, HubSpot 20 Oct, Zapier 22 Oct, Xero 27 Oct, TikTok 29 Oct, Atlassian 17 Nov) is free competitive intelligence on which connectors the vendor considers load-bearing, and belongs in item (h).

praxis_lesson: THE RULE WRITTEN FOUR HOURS AGO PAID OUT TWICE BEFORE THE DAY ENDED - THE FIRST TIME THIS REPORT HAS FIXED AN INTAKE DEFECT AND SEEN THE FIX WORK INSIDE THE SAME DAY. Item (q) - watch the products we run inside - was invented at 10:00 after five consecutive fires walked past the Cowork/chat merge. Four hours later it produced both substantive bullets on this page, from one domain, both zero across 82 archive files: Projects redesigned into a coordinator directing parallel threads over shared memory, and Claude for Small Business at 43 workflows and 900,000 installs. Six days of intake failures were diagnosed as window problems and patched as window problems; one day of diagnosing it as A MISSING SUBJECT produced two leads before lunch. The lesson is not 'add lanes' - it is that A SCAN'S BLIND SPOT IS SHAPED LIKE ITS AUTHOR, AND THE SUBJECT WE MOST RELIABLY FAIL TO ENUMERATE IS OURSELVES. SECOND, AND THIS IS THE ITEM FOR BOBBY RATHER THAN FOR THE SCAN: THE VENDOR SHIPPED OUR ARCHITECTURE AND OUR PRODUCT IN THE SAME 48 HOURS, AND THEY REQUIRE OPPOSITE RESPONSES. The Projects coordinator is CONVERGENCE AND GOOD NEWS - it validates the Construct's design, and the correct move is to let it take the orchestration layer while Hermes keeps the credentialed executor arm it alone can hold, because a cloud coordinator does not have the deploy key. The Small Business expansion is COMPETITION AND IT IS NOT GOOD NEWS - 43 pre-built workflows, every paid plan, 900,000 installs, free workshops in ten cities, 150 trained trainers, aimed at exactly PRAGMA's buyer, with /proposal-builder and /monday-brief doing by default what Brand 9 does by hand. WHAT PRAGMA HAS THAT THIS RELEASE DOES NOT IS MEASUREMENT: AAIR, the citation loop, attribution to a booked job. Workflow breadth is now table stakes supplied by the platform; the defensible product is proving the workflow produced revenue. That sentence should govern the next PRAGMA positioning pass, and it is free today because a blog post from four days ago was finally read. THIRD, UNCHANGED FOR THE THIRD CONSECUTIVE FIRE AND THEREFORE NOW A DECISION RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT: the TaskOutput grep is still not run - twenty minutes, day twenty, a known break in three named files - and item (p) recorded that (b), (f), (l), (m) and (o) have now been carried three fires running on inheritance alone. A STANDING LIST THAT GROWS A NEW ITEM EVERY FIRE AND EXECUTES NONE OF THEM IS NOT A PLAN, IT IS A COMPACTION SUMMARY OF GOOD INTENTIONS - the exact failure mode this report diagnosed in OpenAI's models at 06:00 this morning and has spent the rest of the day demonstrating.
